verdict.rationale: Granola's docs publish a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document at docs.granola.ai/api-reference/openapi.json. It covers the /v1 endpoints and is listed in llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs". The probe 404s were on different candidate paths, so they do not contradict this, and the spec backs an interactive Mintlify playground. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec at the documented path downloads and validates.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Granola publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document ("Granola API", server https://public-api.granola.ai; /v1 endpoints for notes, transcripts, folders, spaces, audit, webhook-endpoints, and legal holds), advertised in the docs llms.txt under "OpenAPI Specs".
This RESTful API enables you to integrate Granola with your existing tools, build custom workflows, and extract insights from your meeting documentation.
